verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's evidence shows one-off, on-demand legal document generators (incorporation, SAFE, Series Seed, NDA), and Cooley AI describes prompt-driven S-1 drafting and updates. Nothing documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. A legal-tech workflow platform could plausibly offer recurring automation, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence it is delivered; probes also found no API or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
